reasons: Billed weight (350 lb) exceeds BOL weight (295 lb) with no re‑weigh certificate (clause 5.2).
Fuel surcharge listed as an accessorial; schedule C does not list a fuel surcharge (clause 4.1).
Calculated contract net linehaul: base rate $166.26/CWT × 2.95 CWT = $490.47; after 72.5% discount = $134.88 (minimum charge $134).
Fuel surcharge per contract: 27.04% of net linehaul = $36.46.
Contract‑supported total = $134.88 + $36.46 = $171.34; invoice total = $203.30, over by $31.96 (>1%).
decision.dispute_summary: Invoice total exceeds contract‑supported amount by $31.96 (≈18.6% over). Fuel surcharge was billed as an accessorial (not allowed) and weight was increased to 350 lb without a certified re‑weigh, violating the weight clause. Both items cause the invoice to be non‑payable.
